newsitem.title: JAPAN: Miyakoshi says China firm is now top shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Miyakoshi says China firm is now top shareholder.

text.p: Miyakoshi Corp said on Thursday that a Chinese company had become its largest shareholder.

The Japanese electrical equipment maker said in a statement that the Chinese company was based in Qingdao, Shandong Province, and sells electronic parts. It could not immediately give the Chinese firm's name in English.
Miyakoshi said it did not know anything about the Chinese firm, including the reason for the share acquisition.
The Chinese company now owns 7.4 million, or 20.11 percent, of Miyakoshi's outstanding shares, it said.
Miyakoshi said that until very recently it did not know that the Chinese firm had obtained its shares.
